items.title: Mrs. Charlotte Botney and Mrs. Bertha George McCullum Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: He taught Alvin. He taught Alvin. Everything you know. He taught Alvin.

ctx.x: I'll get a copy for you. I'll get it. I hope it'll be big enough to see. Yeah. I wonder, did your husband make any records? No. They didn't make many before 1921. They didn't buy them.
